objects.name: Analytic 2125
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a scripting interpreter or custom binary on an Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux asset making sustained, high-frequency Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol read connections to field device IPs, from a User Identifier (UID) not associated with the recognized historian or Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) service account. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: auditd:SYSCALL
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): execve of scripting interpreter with sustained network connect() calls to device subnet at rate exceeding poll baseline, by User Identifier (UID) not in service account allowlist

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Allowlist of OPC client application identities authorized to connect.
IP allowlist of legitimate SCADA/HMI/historian servers authorized to poll field devices.
Measured normal polling frequency per device, derived from actual baseline traffic capture.
Documented register/tag address ranges that legitimate SCADA polling actually queries.
